name: amb
text: Inside the cockpit of a small business jet in a steep high-speed dive: loud roaring wind rush, two screaming jet engines, the airframe rattling, an urgent repeating electronic warning alarm tone. No speech, no music.

name: drop
text: Cinematic slow-motion transition: roaring wind and engine noise suddenly pitches down and stretches as time slows, sinking into a deep sub-bass drone. No music.

name: slowmo
text: Extreme slow motion of an aircraft hitting the ground, heard from inside the cockpit: very deep groaning and buckling aluminium, slow metallic tearing and creaking, low rumbling earth, muffled and heavy, slowly building in intensity. No speech, no music.

name: rewind
text: Fast tape rewind: a video scrubbing backwards quickly, rising whirr and reversed whoosh, ending abruptly with a click.

name: crash
text: A jet aircraft slams into the ground at full speed: an instant enormous impact with no build-up, violent metal crunch and a burst of debris, extremely loud and short.

name: pop
text: A bold punchy whoosh into a deep cinematic impact hit, short and clean, like a modern trailer title slamming onto the screen.

name: flap
text: One single crisp mechanical clack of a split-flap display digit flipping over, dry and close, no reverb.
